Sandbox_WorldQuest_HerramientasPrueba_to: Adds [Test] options to the right-click menu inside your territories: force crises, bring a colonist and fill the storage.
Sandbox_WorldQuest_FrecuenciaCrisis_tool: Multiplies the daily crisis chance. At 0 there are no random crises.
Sandbox_WorldQuest_Produccion_tooltip: Multiplies what colonists deliver each day.
Sandbox_WorldQuest_Costos_tooltip: Multiplies the materials required by level upgrades and buildings.
Sandbox_WorldQuest_Duracion_tooltip: Sets the pace of colonies, buildings and crises. Fast: about 3 hours. Normal: about 6. Long: about 12.
Sandbox_WorldQuest_ModoInicio_tooltip: Where each player appears. Free: wherever they choose. Fair: everyone as far apart as possible. Small town: everyone in the same town. Random: a random scenario.
Sandbox_WorldQuest_NieblaDeGuerra_toolti: You only see what is near you. The rest stays as it was the last time you saw it.
Sandbox_WorldQuest_LimiteHoras_tooltip: If nobody wins before, whoever is first wins. With 0 it uses the duration's: 6, 10 or 12 hours. Max: 12.
